description: Change the token of an existing affiliate link. WARNING: the old token stops tracking immediately — links already shared with it break. Prefer rewardful_create_affiliate_link to add a second token. Rewardful: PUT /v1/affiliate_links/:id.

token.description: Link token, e.g. `jb007` for ?via=jb007. Letters, numbers and dashes only.

name: rewardful_update_affiliate_link
title: Change an affiliate link's token
